title: Following up after a job application? Here's how to find the right hiring manager...
description:
If you’ve applied to a job and get the cold-shoulder empty inbox here’s how to find right person to follow up with. First off check the job description for the hiring manager’s name and if it isn’t there check the company’s LinkedIn page for a possible connection. #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips #jobsearchtips
